comment: Human-curated catalogue for the brain-games cartridge deck. The authoritative per-file metadata lives in games/manifest.json (generated by tools/build_manifest.py from each game's JSDoc header). This file pins the desired category ordering and short category blurbs shown in the picker.

Sports.label: Sports
Sports.blurb: Aim, power, and timing. Attention builds focus; meditation steadies the shot.

Calm.label: Calm
Calm.blurb: Meditation-led sessions. Slow breath, steady mind, smooth motion.

Focus.label: Focus
Focus.blurb: Attention-driven challenges. Sustain focus to progress.

Brain Games.label: Brain Games
Brain Games.blurb: Classic arcade shells modulated by EEG — Snake, Invaders, Breakout.

optional: Muse EEG headset (via Web Bluetooth) — or the built-in simulator
